basic_info.description: Tucked away on a tranquil cul-de-sac in Corona Heights, 44 Museum Way offers a rare blend of space, style, and sweeping views. This sun-filled tri-level condo features a bright living room with cozy fireplace, open dining area, and chef's kitchen with bar seating. Floor-to-ceiling sliders extend the living space to a large deckideal for morning coffee with Twin Peaks as your backdrop. A convenient half bath completes this level.  Downstairs, the primary suite includes an en-suite bath and generous closet, while two additional bedrooms share a full hall bath. An oversized bonus room/playroom with in-unit laundry and ample storage provides flexibility for family or hobbies.  The lower level with interior access offers a private flex space with full bath and deckperfect as a home office, gym, or studio. Throughout, hardwood floors, fresh paint, and modern fixtures elevate the home's appeal. Deeded 1-car parking and abundant storage add everyday ease.  Across from Corona Heights Park and steps to the Randall Museum, playgrounds, and Muni, you're minutes to Castro, Cole Valley, and Noe Valley dining and shops. A true city gem blending tranquility, versatility, and iconic views.
